nom: Neutrogena Rapid Wrinkle Repair Retinol Renewal Serum

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report mixed results: several say the serum did not dry out or irritate their skin at all, but one reports it made her skin extremely dry and flaky, forcing her to cut back to every other night.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe their skin as sensitive or fragrance-reactive report no redness, stinging or irritation, including one who safely uses it around her sensitive eye area.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report smoother, more even-toned skin and diminished wrinkles, with one noting it also helped fade old sunspots; a couple mention mild, temporary dryness in the first few nights that resolved once paired with a moisturizer.
segments.normal: Reviewers with normal skin, including one leaning slightly dry, report the serum absorbs without greasiness and causes no dryness or irritation.
segments.mature: Reviewers who describe their skin as mature or aging, spanning their 30s to nearly 80, report visibly softer, smoother, firmer skin and reduced fine lines within one to two weeks, though one with dry, mature skin hadn't seen a significant change after just one week of use.

concerns.aging: The large majority of reviewers report visibly reduced fine lines, wrinkles and pore size within one to two weeks, along with firmer, plumper-looking skin, though a handful of reviewers who had only used it for a few days say they hadn't yet noticed a dramatic change.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the serum feels hydrating and does not dry out their skin the way other retinol products have, but a few report some dryness, and one reviewer experienced extreme dryness and flaking that led her to cut back to every other night.
concerns.redness: Reviewers who specifically mention redness, including one with sensitive-prone skin, report none from using this serum.
concerns.spots: Reviewers using it for sun damage or dark spots report gradual lightening and improved tone and texture over about two weeks, though one reviewer says she can still see signs of her previous hyperpigmentation despite other improvements.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with acne-prone skin reports no issues, but two others describe a breakout or purge shortly after starting, including one whose jawline and chin broke out badly enough that she would not recommend the product, and another whose chin broke out but who frames it as a sign the retinol was working.

aspects.libelle: Dropper applicator is messy or imprecise
Strong value next to pricier retinol serums
Can cause a tingle or purge at first use

extraits.titre: Didn't work for my skin type
extraits.texte: I am a user of retinol so was excited to try this version from neutrogena. I have hormonal acne along my jawlines occasionally but have been less mild of late. I I produced this product and it totally broke me out on my jawlines and chin. I'm not sure if others were purging or this was too strong for my skin but not a product id recommend as a result.

This product was easy to apply. It did make my skin extremely dry, which it did state could. I cut back to using every other night as my skin did start to flake. I don't really know if I see a real difference, outside if the dryness. I'm a lover of Neutrogena products, just not this one.

I have a dry mature skin, and have wrinkles and find lines around my eyes and mouth. I tried this serum for a week, but I don't see any significant changes so far. I like this serum a lot though. It's a beginner friendly retinol. It's lightweight and sink into skin quickly. Very gentle. My skin is not at the best right now, but I don't get any irritation. There is almost no scent. It was an easy addition to my evening skincare routine. I plan to continue using it until I finish the bottle. I'm looking forward to seeing the results.

I have wanted to try something from this Rapid Wrinkle Repair line for a while, and I'm so thrilled with the results! I have a current face care regime that includes retinol. The results in the pictures are from only changing my current retinol to the new Retinol Renewal Serum. I have sun damage from tanning in my 20s on my face especially with dark spots along my cheek bones. After using for 14 days, I can see some smoothing of the deeper wrinkles, a reduction in size of my pores, a lightening of the spots along my cheek bones and the overall texture and tone has greatly improved. The serum is like a light lotion and absorbs quickly, I had no irritation, and it has a light fragrance but smells great! This retinol performs better than more expensive brands that I have tried. If you are not quite happy with your current retinol results and are looking for more or are just starting out, I recommend trying because it is such an affordable option.

extraits.titre: Good product from a brand I love & trust
extraits.texte: This serum is wonderful! I love Neutrogena and I always have had great experiences with all of their products. This Rapid Wrinkle Repair Retinol Renewal Serum did not disappoint! Ive been using it for a few weeks now and my pores are diminishing. My wrinkles and fine lines are still there however they look smoother and less harsh. My skin feels so soft and already a little firmer. I cant wait to see what it does after a month of use. I will continue using this serum daily and i would recommend it to anyones skin care routine. Im 51 and my only regret is that I didn't start a skincare routine sooner. It is never too early to use a good serum and moisturizer!

The Neutrogena Rapid Wrinkle Repair Retinol Renewal Serum is excellent for my combination skin. I have noticeable wrinkles and fine lines and this product feels amazing over the skin as it helps in diminishing them plus helps my skin heal from sunspots. I live the formula and how elegant the product is with readable clear instructions in usage. The formula glides easily into skin and the skin feels amazing even after the first usage. The continued use of this product has proven effective over my skin as it soothes it and provides excellent results.

This lightweight retinol serum has quickly become a staple in my skincare routine. I've been using it each morning and it hasn't caused any redness or sensitivity to my sensitive-prone skin. I've noticed that my skin feels smoother, the fine lines around my eyes have decreased, and my skin now has a beautiful glow.
